summary: Joshua leads Israel to the Jordan—The Lord cuts off the water of the Jordan; it stands up as a heap, and Israel passes over on dry ground.
meta_description: Joshua leads Israel to the Jordan—The Lord cuts off the water of the Jordan; it stands up as a heap, and Israel passes over on dry ground.

footnotes.note5_a: IE Make yourselves clean, holy, by ritual washings and proper behavior. Ex. 19:10; Josh. 7:13; D&C 43:16 (11–16).
